decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records one commission for every non-promotional no-referral mint and preserves weighted-draw recipient selection.
The same-message MODIFY already records one commission for every non-promotional mint using an accepted referral code.
The same-message MODIFY already records one ticket per coded-referral mint and excludes promotional mints.

The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the obsolete six-ticket explanation with one ticket and one commission per non-promotional mint, including weighted-draw allocation for referral-free mints.
Changing reward quantities and excluding promotional mints does not alter which referral identifiers are valid or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The reward-allocation change does not alter the NFT token serial used as the permanent referral code or where that code is displayed.
The number of tickets and commissions generated per mint does not change how book access, referral identity, badges, or existing ticket state transfer with an NFT.
The source changes reward issuance quantities but does not change which metadata fields must be visible or the source of the referral-code attribute.
The current About-page state contains no conflicting per-mint no-referral ticket or commission quantity that the source decision necessarily changes.
The reward-allocation rule does not change the email provider, delivery behavior, notification channels, or required transactional-email contents.
The current landing-page state does not assert an incompatible no-referral reward quantity, and the source does not necessarily require a copy or layout revision.
Changing ticket issuance to one per non-promotional mint does not alter the Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, eligibility method, or pool funding.
